title: Arrest by private person
question: What does Ndlea Act section 30 say about arrest by private person?
shortAnswer: Ndlea Act s.30 — Private person may arrest for drug offence in presence; hand to NDLEA/police.
legalExplanation:
**Section 30 of the Ndlea Act** provides:

Private person may arrest for drug offence in presence; hand to NDLEA/police

This provision empowers Ndlea Act officers with specific powers and duties.
practicalOptions: Stay calm. Know your rights. Ask for identification. Do not resist. Ask for lawyer. Document everything.
whatToAvoid: Do not run, bribe, resist, destroy evidence, or sign without lawyer.
whatToDocument: Officer name, agency, badge, vehicle, time, location, witnesses, injuries, photos/video.
whatToDoAfter: Get lawyer. File complaint with agency complaints unit or ICPC/PCR. Demand court within 24h. Document injuries.
